task_objective: Implement filename/folder catalog columns and make value-count charts scrollable, debounced, and stale-result safe.
tests_added: Catalog model filename, folder, and full-path tooltip coverage
Folder delegate colour-direction and ElideLeft coverage
Catalog File resize, Folder stretch, and 450 px basename visibility coverage
Value-count chart scroll range, 10,000-row culling, and fixed-row paint-position coverage
Top N debounce coalescing, constant interval, and stale-worker result rejection coverage
Dock filename rendering now reads the DisplayRole value, and Folder stretch is checked at narrow and wide dock widths
test_rationale: Existing catalog column-index expectations moved because Folder is a required fifth column; the row-selection expectation now includes that fifth visible cell.
The fixed-height paint assertion uses ascending bar lengths and a midpoint pixel so the specified compressed-row mutation cannot accidentally pass by sampling a longer earlier bar.

The initial value-count test commits df5768f and cb0c050 followed their implementation commits because mutation checks exposed weak coverage; they were added as focused regression fences, then reviewer mutation testing independently confirmed their load-bearing behavior.
design_decisions: The File model value is Path.name, while Folder displays Path.parent and both retain the full path in their tooltip.
FolderColumnDelegate left-elides and dims only Text and WindowText, preserving selected-row HighlightedText.
ValueCountsChart owns a fixed 24 px row height and exposes its full content height to a QScrollArea; paint work is culled to the exposed rectangle while scale uses all counts.
A single-shot 300 ms timer coalesces Top N changes, and only the most recently launched worker may apply a result.
